# Heading

A section title with its count and a link.

`custom:fluvy-heading-card` · [Try it live](https://acosta290.github.io/fluvy/?card=heading) · [All cards](../cards.md#structure-and-navigation)

<picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../images/cards/heading-dark.webp"><img src="../images/cards/heading-light.webp" width="392" alt="The Heading card, drawn from the example below"></picture>

## Example

```yaml
type: custom:fluvy-heading-card
title: Living room
icon: fluvy:home
subtitle: '4 devices'
path: /fluvy-home/living
```

The picture above, on the demo house: put your own entities in place of its.

## Layouts

`variant` chooses the layout. The picture above is `bar`, the default; each of the others is the example plus the line over it, and opens in the live demo.

## All options

```yaml
type: custom:fluvy-heading-card
title: Living room
heading_style: subtitle
icon: fluvy:home
variant: bar
subtitle: '4 devices'
path: /fluvy-home/living
# entities:
# tap_action:
```

## Options

| Option | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` |  | The heading’s words. |
| `heading_style` | `subtitle` | The heading’s size: a page’s title, a group’s, or a quiet label. `title` · `subtitle` · `label`. |
| `icon` |  | The card’s icon, in place of the entity’s own. |
| `variant` | `bar` | The card’s layout. `bar` · `plain`. |
| `subtitle` |  | The line under the title: your own words, an entity’s state or a template. |
| `path` |  | Where a tap on the heading goes. |
| `entities` |  | Entities whose state the heading shows at its end. A list of entities. |
